description: This file contains automated test cases for the PreviewThemeAPI class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically targeting the API's behavior related to previewing themes in the corporate branding plugin.

classes.name: PreviewThemeAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class extending EndpointIntegrationTestCase to test the PreviewThemeAPI endpoints related to theme preview functionalities.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests the create method of the PreviewThemeAPI using data provider for parameterized testing.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestCreate
methods.description: Provides test cases data for the testCreate method, sourcing from a YAML configuration file.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Verifies that calling delete on the API throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Verifies that getting validation rules for delete throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Verifies that getAll throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Verifies that getting validation rules for getAll throws a not implemented exception.
